connections.why: Transfers are how energy moves between stores within a system
Real transfers dissipate energy, motivating efficient resources
Internal energy is the energy stored in a substance's particles
Work done by a force transfers energy to a moving object
Resultant force determines the acceleration of an object
Pressure is force spread over an area within a fluid
Forces acting at a distance create turning moments
Stopping distances follow from acceleration and braking forces
Light is a transverse wave sharing properties with all waves
Electromagnetic waves transfer energy through space
A current in a wire produces a magnetic field
Generators and transformers transfer energy electromagnetically
Gamma rays are emitted from unstable atomic nuclei
Nuclear fission and fusion are major energy sources
Red shift of light reveals the expansion of the universe
Gravity provides the centripetal force that holds orbits
